name: edgar_registration_statements
description:
Securities registration statements (S-1 IPO, S-3 shelf, S-4 business combination, S-8 employee plan) for one company, from SEC EDGAR (data.sec.gov submissions).
Returns {cik, company_name, form_type, filings_count, filings: [{accessionNumber, filingDate, reportDate, form, primaryDocument, primaryDocDescription, document_url}]}, newest first; document_url is an SEC viewer link.
Inputs (* required): cik* (string, the CIK), form_type (S-1 | S-3 | S-4 | S-8; default S-1), limit (integer 1-50, default 10).
Only the recent-filings block of the EDGAR submissions file is searched. Amendments (S-1/A) are not included; edgar_filings_by_form covers other forms.
Example: {"cik": "0001318605", "form_type": "S-8"}

cik.description: Central Index Key (CIK), up to 10 digits

form_type.description: Registration form: S-1, S-3, S-4 or S-8
